Core Service Offering

IT & Cloud Services

Build and modernize technology infrastructure that supports your business across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud with clean Infrastructure as Code.

Discuss Your Project Explore All Services

The Business Problem

Unmanaged cloud sprawl, manual deployments prone to human error, unexpected cloud billing spikes, and brittle on-premises servers that introduce single points of failure.

Suitable For

Enterprises transitioning workloads to modern cloud platforms, organizations adopting Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), and businesses needing structured deployment automation.

Deliverables & Scope

Cloud Infrastructure Capabilities

Cloud Workload Migration

Structured migration of databases, web servers, and internal applications to AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud with planned staging environments and rollback plans.

AWS EC2 / RDS Azure Virtual Machines Google Cloud Engine

Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC)

Codified infrastructure environments using Terraform to ensure reproducible, auditable, and version-controlled provisioning across all environments.

Terraform Ansible GitOps

Containerization & Orchestration

Containerizing legacy and modern applications with Docker and Kubernetes for consistent runtime execution, easier horizontal scaling, and faster releases.

Docker Kubernetes EKS / AKS / GKE

CI/CD & Release Automation

Automated testing and continuous delivery pipelines via GitHub Actions or GitLab CI, eliminating manual SSH deploys and reducing release risks.

GitHub Actions GitLab CI Automated Rollbacks
Methodology

The Cloud Delivery Process

01

Workload Audit

Inventory analysis of compute, network, database schemas, and dependencies.

02

IaC Blueprint

Authoring clean Terraform modules and staging test environments.

03

Phased Migration

Scheduled data migration with synchronization and switchover validation.

04

Optimization & Retainer

Cost monitoring, automated alerts, and ongoing maintenance retainers.

Frequently Asked Questions

Cloud Services FAQs

Our standard model uses an upfront setup fee for architecture assessment, migration engineering, and IaC implementation, followed by an optional monthly retainer for continuous infrastructure optimization and support.
We design and implement architectures across Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and hybrid hosting providers depending on your technical requirements and regional latency constraints.
